description: Solve logistics coordination as a freight broker multi-modal professional on Mac. Learn to reduce manual admin and reclaim your workday.
intro: Logistics coordination for a freight broker multi-modal specialist is a constant battle against manual data entry and fragmented communication. If you feel like a human data relay instead of a logistics expert, you are experiencing the primary bottleneck of modern freight brokerage.
tldr: Most freight brokers spend 65% of their day on non-revenue tasks like data entry.
Logistics coordination suffers because of disconnected tools and manual email handling.
You can improve efficiency by centralizing data and automating routine status updates.
Lazur helps you handle these tasks on your Mac by pointing at buttons, explaining processes, and drafting communications.

blocks.text: Logistics coordination is a systemic challenge for any freight broker multi-modal operation. You are likely moving between email, load boards, and a TMS to manually reconcile shipments. This creates a productivity trap where being busy is mistaken for being productive. When you spend your time re-keying zip codes or chasing proof of delivery documents, you are not managing logistics. You are performing manual data entry. This work is prone to errors, and it keeps you in a reactive state where you only respond to fires instead of planning ahead.

The root of the problem is fragmentation. You likely use a web-based TMS, but your communication happens in Gmail or Outlook. Your capacity data lives on a load board, and your carrier compliance documents might be in a separate portal. Every time you move data between these silos, you add a step that can fail. Market volatility makes this worse. When fuel prices shift or a driver faces a delay, you have to manually update every stakeholder. This manual intervention is the primary cause of burnout in the industry.

items: Centralize your data: Use a single TMS that integrates with your email to minimize switching between tabs.
Automate status updates: Set up automated notifications for your customers and carriers to reduce the number of check calls.
Standardize carrier vetting: Use a single platform for safety and compliance to avoid jumping between multiple sites.
Implement shared rotations: If you work in a team, use a rotation for after-hours work to prevent individual burnout.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you on your Mac

Lazur lives in your Mac notch and helps you manage these tasks without clicking through endless menus. When you are stuck, hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur about any element on your screen. If you cannot find a specific setting in your web-based TMS, ask Lazur to point it out. It will draw a circle around the button for you.

Imagine you need to draft a carrier onboarding email. Instead of typing it from scratch, hold fn and dictate the core details. Lazur turns your voice into clean, formatted text directly in your email client. If you need to research a new lane, use Lazur to run a search in the background. It will summarize the results so you can make a faster decision.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with legacy TMS software?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any application on your Mac. If you are running legacy software via Parallels or Citrix, Lazur can still see the screen and help you navigate, though it works best with modern web-based platforms.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate apps for you. It points at elements, explains how to do things, and helps you work faster by providing information and drafting text.

faq.question: Is my data safe when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen and listens to your voice while you hold the shortcut. The audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers to answer your request and are not stored. Your data is never used to train AI models.
